_comment: A cooldown that spawns a stationary Fire Totem which burns every enemy in its range rather than just the nearest one, unlike the single-target Summon Totem pattern. Skill level raises the totem's lifespan and loadout level; owner level adds its power. The cooldown is longer than the totem's max lifespan so only one totem exists at a time. All values placeholder.
name: FireTotem
